basis: Week 4 results (Ridge calendar+season MAPE 5.2-6.4%, seasonal naive 6.8-7.0%, last value 10.6-27.4%), Week 1 literature (Makridakis et al. 2018: ML not better on short monthly series), 8 products x 24-60 training months
claims: No ML model beats Ridge F2 by more than 0.5 percentage points MAPE at any horizon.
A single decision tree is clearly worse than Ridge (>= 1 point).
Adding the extra feature groups (F7) does not help any algorithm by more than 0.3 points.
Surge classifier: precision and recall both between 0.70 and 0.92 for the best model; all models beat persistence.
